question: Who among the following was appointed as the Chairman of ICC Men's Cricket Committee in November 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sourav Ganguly**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) **President and former India captain **Sourav Ganguly** has been appointed as **the chairman of the International Cricket Council (ICC) Men's Cricket Committee.**
 
• He** replaced Anil Kumble** in the role.
 
• **Anil Kumble** stepped down as chairman of the ICC Cricket Committee after he** served a maximum of three-year terms.**
 
• **Ganguly served as President** of the** Cricket Association of Bengal between 2015 and 2019** and **took over as BCCI president in October 2019.**
 
• 
 
The decision was taken at the **International Cricket Council (ICC) Board Meeting in Dubai.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**__**Kapil Dev**__

__
 
• **Kapil Dev Ramlal Nikhanj** is an **Indian former cricketer.**
 
• He was a** fast-medium bowler **and a** hard-hitting middle-order batsman** and was named by Wisden as the Indian Cricketer of the Century in 2002.
 
• Dev captained the Indian cricket team that **won the 1983 Cricket World Cup.**

**Anil Kumble**__

__
 
• **Anil Kumble** is a **former Indian cricket captain**, **coach, and commentator.**
 
• He played Test and One Day International cricket for his national team over an international **career of 18 years.**
 
• Widely regarded as one of** the best leg-spin bowlers in Test cricket history,** he took **619 wickets in Test cricket.**
 
• He is the** fourth highest wicket-taker of all time as of 2022.**

**Sunil Gavaskar**__

__
 
• **Sunil Manohar Gavaska**r is an** Indian cricket commentator and former cricketer **who represented India and Bombay from 1971 to 1987.
 
• Gavaskar is acknowledged as one of **the greatest opening batsmen of all time.**
 
• Gavaskar was widely admired for his technique against **fast bowling**, with a particularly high average of** 65.45 against the West Indies.**
 
• He possessed a four-pronged fast bowling attack regarded as the most vicious in Test history. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **Confusion Points__**

 
• The composition of the ICC Board is as follows :
 
 
• **ICC Chairman is Greg Barclay (ICC Chair). **
 
• **ICC Men's Cricket Committee Chairman is Sourav Ganguly. **
 
• **Women's Cricket Committee Chairman is Clare Connor. **
 
• **India's representative in ICC is Jay Shah.**
